anomalies.evidence: downstream photo, channel bed: pieces of plastic litter and garbage scattered in the water.

scene.note: Concrete canalized urban stream channel with shallow water flow.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo: wide, flat concrete bed with sloping concrete side walls.

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, stream bed: smooth artificial concrete channel floor visible through shallow water.

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, both banks: sloping artificial concrete walls.

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo: patch of green vegetation rooted in water on the right and a small water drop over a sill on the left.

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no fallen trees, branches, or leaf deposits in the channel.

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, mid-channel: shallow water flowing smoothly across the bed and over a low drop.

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo: the concrete channel bottom is clearly visible through the water.

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no water withdrawal pipes, pumps, or intakes visible.

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo, mid-channel: an artificial concrete weir step drops the water level across the channel.

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no pipes discharging visible polluted water into the channel.

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no visible sewage discharge or grey water entering the channel.

findings.question: construction
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no active construction machinery, works, or fencing in the stream.

findings.evidence: downstream photo, foreground banktop (right margin): extensive cracked concrete slab covering more than one third of the margin.

findings.question: vegetation_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, far banktop (left margin): mature trees growing along the top of the bank.

findings.question: vegetation_type_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, far banktop (left margin): mature trees form the dominant vegetation.

findings.question: vegetation_type_right
